content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge resolves the Acts 2:30 loins/seed collision by comparing the defender's read-together chain ([CR2]/[CR3]) with the challenger's read-together chain ([DR3]) and finding neither forces the other.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D5 vs C1 (Acts 2:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] and [CR3] answered the loins/seed row with Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10 (loins at depth) and the legal/flesh distinction, while [DR3] presses that the only named Davidic man is Joseph; neither chain forces the other.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"none","why":"The judge treats the dispute as a chain-against-chain collision and does not rest on a single pressed verse failing to state the contrary."}
